corpora.008: concatenated same-speaker streams stream-2277-{01,02} (26-28s, corpus/real/manifest-streams.json) — short clips cannot exercise mid-utterance emission

emission_008.note: feature 008 progressive emission, whisper-tiny CPU, long-stream corpus (results/bench-008-rebaseline.jsonl, re-measured 2026-07-28 after the character-level dedupe + overlap-bound fix; supersedes bench-008-streams.jsonl). SC-001 targets: ttfu <= 2s, ttfc <= 5s. SC-003: streaming WER within 2pp of batch.

emission_008_small_transducers.note: feature 008 US3/US4, x86_64 CPU, long-stream corpus (results/bench-008-small-snaps.jsonl, 2026-07-29, dev/bench-008-small-snaps.sh). parakeet = Parakeet TDT 0.6B v3 int8 (murmure quantization) via the numpy/onnxruntime port, SilenceCut chunked commit (15s arm / 500ms pause cut / 60s force cut, decode-once, no unstable by design). sherpa = k2-fsa streaming FastConformer transducer en 480ms int8 via sherpa-onnx OnlineRecognizer (native partials + rule endpointing).

notes: SC-001: PASS for local-agreement (ttfu 1.4-1.7s <= 2s; ttfc 2.4-3.5s <= 5s) and tail-mutation ttfu; tail-mutation ttfc 6.8-7.9s exceeds 5s (segment-holdback latency by design); fixed-head ttfc 17.6-20.2s reflects the 15s arm constant.
SC-002/SC-004: PASS — commit stability 100% across all strategies and the sweep.

SC-003: PASS for fixed-head (0pp — decode-once-at-pause is batch-quality); MARGINAL for local-agreement and tail-mutation (+2.4pp vs 2.0pp tolerance) on whisper-tiny/greedy. Beam size ruled out as the cause (beam5 sweep: LA 10.2% vs 10.8% pre-dedupe, TM unchanged) — the delta is inherent AED re-decode right-context loss at commit boundaries; expect it to narrow on larger models (re-measure with whisper-base/small on the GPU tier).

Boundary-duplication bug class found and fixed during the sweep: word-timestamp drift between decodes leaks duplicated words at commit frontiers (e.g. 'USUAL. USUAL.'); fixed with text-alignment overlap dedupe in the emission loop (LA 10.8% -> 7.2%, TM 13.2% -> 7.2%).

2026-07-28 rebaseline (dev/rebaseline-streaming-watermarks.sh): the character-level frontier-anchored dedupe (d7d9c72) regressed TM to 12.0% on first re-measure — its anywhere-in-stream suffix search matched the committed-tail suffix at the END of a genuinely-new decode ('no answer' repeated) and dropped 9 new words. Fixed by bounding the claimed duplicate region to _MAX_OVERLAP_WORDS (5): old content re-transcribes only the window's 1 s overlap audio, so a longer claim is coincidence and the alignment abstains (under-drop leaks a visible duplicate; over-drop silently loses words). Post-fix sweep restores batch 4.79 / LA 7.19 / TM 7.19 / FH 4.79 with all emission-invariant tests green.

2026-07-28 strategy triage: with the sweep data clean, tail-mutation and fixed-head were RETIRED — LA was the only SC-001 pass (ttfc 2.4-3.5s vs TM 6.8-7.8s; FH ~18s, no unstable) at equal WER, with the strongest right-context guarantee of the re-decode pair and no whisper-segment dependencies. FH's decode-once == batch WER control result stands as evidence the +2.4pp re-decode gap is right-context loss, not plumbing. Batch mode is the floor for any tier where re-decode is unaffordable; chunked revival lives in git history. myna-server --strategy removed.

Run variance: repeat LA sweeps on identical code vary ±0.6 pp (7.19-7.78%, 12-13/167 edits) — cadence ticks land at different wall-clock offsets vs audio chunks, shifting commit boundaries and whisper segment decisions. Treat sub-1pp strategy deltas on this 2-clip corpus as noise.
GPU-tier watermarks (nemotron native, whisper-base/small) require the lab hardware; extend via dev/matrix.py.

2026-07-29 small transducers (US3/US4): parakeet chunked-commit is the accuracy leader — streaming WER <= batch (2.2/0.0% vs 4.4/0.0%; decode-once has no re-decode right-context tax, and pause-bounded chunks give the nemo128 utterance-global CMVN utterance-like statistics) — at the cost of no partials and ttfc ~= arm+pause (17.8-20.4s). sherpa native is the latency leader — first partial 1.35s, finalize ~0.01s (frame-once) — at +2.2-2.6pp WER vs its batch (endpoint context cost) and no punctuation on this model. sherpa ttfc on stream-02 (20.5s) shows endpoint rules need the same pauses SilenceCut does.

2026-07-29 weights discriminator (US3): istupakov's HF int8 encoder collapses (blank output mid-audio) non-monotonically on some inputs — the nemo128 preprocessor does utterance-global CMVN, so feature statistics shift with window length and that quantization can't absorb the shift (12/14/18/20-22s prefixes of stream-2277-01 fail; 15-17/19/28s decode). sherpa's k2 int8 is intermediate (22s collapse). murmure's bundled re-quantization decodes every probed length — US3 ships murmure's weights (dev/fetch_parakeet_onnx.py, pinned + sha256).

2026-07-29 SilenceCut port bug found by the sweep: murmure checks the silence-run cut every 33ms tick; the first port checked only at observe() call boundaries, so a pause ending mid-call reset the run before the check saw it (stream-2277-02's 1.1s pause missed, no mid-audio commit). Fixed: cut at the frame where the run crosses.
